opening.argument: The video presents a practical tutorial for assembling relaxation or meditation videos from royalty-free footage and music, including instructions to verify commercial-use rights and attribution requirements. It explains that advertising revenue begins only after channel monetization and frames success as requiring substantial work, with generally 50 to 100 videos needed before success. Although it discusses possible earnings and promotes discounted training and mentoring, the earnings disclaimer expressly states that no money is guaranteed. The promotional offer is disclosed through the stated discount and description link, while the licensing conditions, education-focused instruction, and absence of a promised outcome do not establish deceptive conduct.
